la Trinitat Nova — Barcelona, Spain

Relatively safer day Higher caution advised night

In detail

A 2019 profile piece explicitly stated the barri's reputation for insecurity is 'not a safety issue' and driven by economic/social factors and poorly lit corners, not crime. However, Trinitat Nova metro station has a documented pattern of serious late-night violence against transit security staff: a March 2022 assault leaving a guard with a broken hand, and a 22 Nov 2025 attack by ~10 young people using pepper spray, bottles and an expandable baton that left a guard needing 12 stitches (attackers arrested Dec 2025, barred from the metro). This is a real, repeated night-time violence pattern at this specific station. Sources checked: metropoliabierta.elespanol.com, Apr 2019 / Mar 2022 / 23 Nov 2025; elcaso.elnacional.cat, Dec 2025.
